name: Moyu Shanju Hotel
aiSummary: Review summary Powered by AI Accommodation & Cleanliness:Rooms are spacious, clean, and well-maintained, with wooden furnishings, large beds, and bunk beds suitable for families. topics.text: Rooms are spacious, clean, and well-maintained, with wooden furnishings, large beds, and bunk beds suitable for families. Bathrooms are tidy, equipped with complete toiletries, and bedding is fresh and comfortable.

Staff and hosts are consistently described as friendly, attentive, and helpful, providing personalized recommendations for local attractions, meals, and activities. Their warmth and responsiveness enhance the overall guest experience.

The property blends natural elements with rustic design, featuring greenery, a serene atmosphere, and aesthetically pleasing interiors ideal for photography. The layout ensures comfort and privacy for guests.

address: No. 17, Luojiachong, Sanqiao Village, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
